alcohol.answer: Israir's own baggage page could not be read, so the rule here comes from the Israel Airports Authority: alcohol bought at Ben Gurion duty free travels in a sealed packet to Europe and on connections, but alcohol brought from home is not covered.

sections.h: 🥃 What the Israel Airports Authority says about duty-free alcohol
sections.p: Israir's own baggage page could not be read, so this section uses the Israel Airports Authority (IAA) page for Ben Gurion Airport, read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
IAA rule
rows: Alcohol bought at Ben Gurion duty free
Allowed on flights to any European country and on connections to Europe or the USA, if wrapped in a sealed packet at the shop
Alcohol from home or other shops
Duty-free liquids allowed if sealed; at the first US stop the packet must go in the suitcase
Perfume, cosmetics, sprays and gels follow the same sealed-packet rule

list: Not read: Israir's own alcohol limit per person. Ask Israir for its litre limit before you fly.

faq: Can I take duty-free alcohol from Ben Gurion on Israir?
The Israel Airports Authority allows liquids bought in the Ben Gurion duty-free shops, alcohol included, on flights to Europe if they are in a sealed packet; confirm with Israir.
Can I bring alcohol from home in my hand luggage on Israir?
The IAA easing applies only to duty-free purchases at Ben Gurion, not to products brought from home.
sources: Unofficial source: Israel Airports Authority — Ben Gurion Airport security, Flying With Liquids
